metadata.chunk_title: English Language requirements + I am an EU applicant, but I have non-EU exams

value: Matriculation Examinations from European countries where English is presented as a subject and an acceptable level is achieved.
Irish Leaving Certificate English Ordinary Level Grade D or above.
IELTS Minimum score of 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in any component.
ETAPP (English Test for Academic and Professional Purposes) Grade C1.
GCE 'O' Level English Language/GCSE English Language Grade C or above.
Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic Minimum score of 61 (with no section score below 59).

metadata.chunk_title: English Language requirements + I am an EU applicant, but I have non-EU exams

value: Oxford English Test Overall minimum 140. Individual skills 125.
Language Cert ESOL B2 Communicator High Pass with no less than 33 in each skill.

metadata.chunk_title: A-Level Students + The UL minimum entry requirements for A-Levels Students are as follows:

programme_facts.value: 6 distinct recognised subjects which must include 2 subjects at GCE A Level Grade C AND 4 other subjects at GCSE O Level Grade C which must include English, Mathematics and another language.

metadata.chunk_title: A-Level Students + The UL minimum entry requirements for A-Levels Students are as follows:

programme_facts.value: A-Level grades taken over a single sitting may be combined with AS grades from the same year or 1 year previous.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: AVEC - Do not fulfill minimum and specific subject requirements.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: A maximum of four different recognised subjects, which are not mutually exclusive, will be counted.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: If 4 A-levels are presented, the lowest grade is scored at a lower rate.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: Only A-level grades awarded at the same date can be considered for computation.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: Applicants are scored on the basis of their best four A-levels, or three A-levels and an AS level in a different subject from the same or preceding year.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: Grades in the same subject in A2 and AS level cannot be combined.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: In the case of high demand programmes such as Medicine, a numerus clausus may operate: If there is a significant imbalance in the proportions of eligible applicants for a course between Leaving Certificate and other EU qualifications, places are offered to eligible applicants from each examination system group on the basis of ranking within their group.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: For LM301 Medicine, the requirement is that the score must come from the same sitting in which matriculation is met.

metadata.chunk_title: Points to Note:

programme_facts.value: For A-level candidates, this means minimum subject entry requirements for the programme must be met in the normal timeframe of GCSE examinations being presented 2 years prior to the A Level results used for scoring.
